---
title: "Custom mathematical environments"
format: math-web-html
math-web:
  macros: lp-macros.sty
  hooks:
    - lp.lua
---

The Lua module defines how to translate `lp` into aligned math. The extension
handles balanced arguments and environment boundaries; the module chooses the
layout of the objective and constraints. The same translation works with
MathJax and KaTeX.

$$
\begin{lp}{\min_x}{\cost^\top x}
  \lpconstraint[i=1,\ldots,m]{a_i^\top x \ge b_i}
  \lpconstraint{x \ge 0}
\end{lp}
$$

A complete raw LaTeX block can also be translated. This one supplies an explicit
tag. Automatic numbering and cross-references are left to other filters.

\begin{lp}[\mathrm{P}]{\min_x}{\cost^\top x}
  \lpconstraint{Ax \ge b}
  \lpconstraint{x \ge 0}
\end{lp}

The handler introduces `\subjectto`, which is imported from `lp-macros.sty`
alongside the other declarations.
No browser-side environment parser is added.
